data.one_liner: A CustomPainter widget that adds a scanning line effect around a camera view.
data.what_it_does: It draws a moving scanning line with customizable colors and border around any child widget, typically a camera preview. The animation parameters such as delay, duration, height offset and padding are configurable.
use_when: You need a simple visual scanning overlay for a camera preview
You want a lightweight, customizable effect without adding heavy dependencies
avoid_when: You require actual barcode/QR detection logic
You need a full‑featured camera controller or advanced image processing
strengths: Very small and easy to integrate
Highly customizable colors and animation timing
weaknesses: Provides only visual effect, no scanning functionality
Limited configuration compared to full camera packages

alternatives.name: mobile_scanner
alternatives.why_pick_it: Offers built‑in camera preview with scanning overlay and barcode detection in one package

alternatives.name: qr_code_scanner_plus
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides a ready‑made scanning UI plus QR code detection
